title: Deploying on Windows Server
intro: The rule to know first: a container shares the host's kernel. So Windows containers (for example .NET Framework or IIS) run only on Windows hosts, and Linux containers need Linux, or a VM on Windows. Docker Desktop is not supported on Windows Server, so the engine is set up by hand. The container's Windows version usually has to match the host's, unless you use Hyper-V isolation.
